dedupe_keys.name: plant level emissions of air pollutants and co2 in china s cement industry from real time monitoring data 2021 2023

description: This dataset gives emission concentrations, emission factors and absolute emissions of China's cement industry for 2021 to 2023, derived from real-time continuous emission monitoring data, by region, process, technology and plant scale. The DataCite record for the figshare deposit says it was published on 29 April 2025 by eleven authors (Jiabao Qu, Song Lv, Shuangyue Qian, Shuo Qi, Jieyi Li, Hongxia Xu, Xiaojun Lv, Ruxing Wan, Jiansheng Cui, Yinghao Chu and Ling Tang), as downloadable files of about 141 KB, free under CC BY 4.0, with supplementary information on GitHub. Coverage is mainland China at plant level aggregated by region, process and scale. Caveats: the figshare API did not return the file list on 26 September 2026, the number of plants and the pollutants are not stated in the record read, and the published values are aggregates, not a plant list. For simulation it gives emission factors by process and technology to estimate how much air pollution and CO2 changes when cement kilns shut down, restart or switch technology. Related catalogue records include the China Cement Industry Dataset (CCID), the GCP-CEM cement process emissions and the China coking industry monitoring datasets.
